## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the red block with the left arm, switch to the right, and place it on the blue pad.

Task description: Transfer the red long block currently on the left side of the table to the right arm and place it on the blue square mat on the right. The left arm grasps it, and the right arm places it.

Success criteria: After handover from left to right, the center of the red cuboid's originally downward end face must be near the blue mat's top center at mat-surface height. The right gripper must be open and the block released.

## Execution tips

- Enclose two opposite long faces of the block with the fingers, placing the pads on the flat areas away from corners. An opening just wider than the grasp width is sufficient to reduce scraping and misalignment.
- During handover, offset the grasps along the block's long side, leaving the right gripper an upper section away from the end edges to preserve bottom clearance for placement. Confirm an effective right grasp before releasing the left.
- Hand off and adjust the pose in the open area at the center of the table, leaving room for the block’s lower end to swing. Watch especially for the drink bottle left of the blue mat.
- Near the blue mat, observe the block's lower end relative to the surface, fine-tune its end-face center and release only after the mat supports it to avoid toppling from an unsupported release.
